dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: Oh, can you believe it? Arkady, this time I had ten whole lines... Ten! I got to perform an entire scene all by myself. A heart-wrenching one, too, with a mother wailing over her lost child.

dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: Did you see the audience? They were hanging on every word, utterly captivated. I swear, I nearly had them in tears!

dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: ...That was wonderful. I really think they're starting to notice me. Next time... next time, I'm sure they'll give me a bigger part.

dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: And one day, I'll shine just like Odette. The flowers, the applause, everyone's eyes on me... it'll all be mine. Even if I'm not young anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Arkady
dialogues.text: Lucky you, Taisiya... Honestly, I envy you. You still have the energy to to dream about things like that. I spent the whole night without one line...

dialogues.speaker: Arkady
dialogues.text: While you were onstage crying over your dead child as the mother, there I was, dangling in the sky as the moon!

dialogues.speaker: Arkady
dialogues.text: Wow. How tragic. I work hard too, you know. You'd think the stage would give me something in return... besides yellow paint on my face.

dialogues.speaker: Arkady
dialogues.text: Come on, let's get this place cleaned up. I don't have the energy to squeeze out any more feelings tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: Oh, Arkady, must you be such a killjoy?
